sections.title: Personal Yoga
sections.lead: Your class, tailored exactly to you.

sections.title: Personal Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: In your individual class you practice hatha yoga with Susanne, entirely according to your physical needs. Series of exercises are developed specifically for you, which you can also practice at home. In the studio in Coburg or at your home (within a 20 km radius, including Rödental and Neustadt bei Coburg).

items.title: When and where
items.text: In the studio in Coburg or at your home (within 20 km, including Rödental and Neustadt bei Coburg). Fridays 14:00–15:00, other times on request.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
